description: Cross-SDK delegation-chain vectors for L2 Grants in trust records (experimental in AdCP 3.3), copied byte for byte from the v3.3.0-beta.3 release of adcontextprotocol/adcp. They arrived in PR #8473, an erratum to ratified R6; the file is unchanged from that PR's head (3832036f8b2c153b7954992a2ffa06d1f5057898), which adcp-client also vendors.
